headline: Bank of Baroda appoints Mr. Mehrotra Manish Nath as Head of Treasury & Global Markets
summary: Bank of Baroda announced the appointment of Mr. Mehrotra Manish Nath as Head (In-Charge) of Treasury & Global Markets, Special Treasury, Mumbai effective April 18, 2026. He brings over 27 years of experience to the role.
